Healing enters through many doors

You're not a symptom — you're a whole person. Dr. Joan approaches your health through five portals of entry, so nothing important gets missed.

Portal One

Physical

Structure, alignment, and the nervous system — the body's foundation. When interference is removed, healing can begin.

Portal Two

Chemical

Whole-food and herbal nutrition, guided by lab work read from a functional perspective — fuel the body can actually use.

Portal Three

Emotional

Unresolved stress leaves imbalances behind. Gentle mind-body work helps find them — and let them go for good.

Portal Four

Energetic

The body's energy matters too. Restoring its natural flow supports healing at every other level.

Portal Five

Spiritual

Care that honors the whole person — body, soul, and spirit — rooted in Heaven, lived out on earth.

Meet Dr. Joan Housley

A 26-year chiropractic veteran, Dr. Joan specializes in natural healing. She has a passionate heart for seeing her patients restored to wholeness — helping them realize and live up to their full potential.

After spending her high school years abroad in England, she earned her Bachelor of Science from Florida State University and her Doctorate from Life University, then completed thousands of postgraduate hours in emotional healing, whole-food and herbal nutrition, and many physical modalities.

“She has an innate ability to uncover the root cause of issues — then helps uproot them, so hearts, souls, and lives find freedom and restoration.”
  • B.S., Florida State University · Doctorate, Life University
  • Thousands of postgraduate hours in emotional healing, nutrition, and physical modalities
  • 26 years of whole-person chiropractic care

Treatments that treat the cause

Three paths, one goal: remove what's interfering, and let your body do what it was made to do — heal.

Chiropractic & Structural Care

Through precise adjustments and muscle balancing, nerve interference is removed — and the body regains its God-given ability to heal itself. Gentle enough for children, thorough enough for long-standing problems.

NET Neuro Emotional Technique

Neuro Emotional Technique

NET is a mind-body technique that finds and removes neurological imbalances related to unresolved stress. Clearing them can improve many behavioral and physical conditions that haven't responded to anything else.

Nutrition & Supplementation

Whole-food and herbal nutrition, tailored to you. Dr. Joan reads your blood work and lab analysis from a functional perspective, then builds a supplementation plan that supports real change — not guesswork.
